Depuis la fin de matinée, à onze heures: Since late morning, at eleven-thirty, reports have been multiplying on tracking platforms as well as on social networks. Subscribers to the Orange and Sosh brands are facing a total interruption of their mobile telephony and internet connection services, affecting all daily usage across the country.
À treize heures, le nombre de personnes: By one o'clock, the number of people deprived of connection had already reached ten thousand, while the situation remained particularly complex during the afternoon. The operator officially acknowledged the existence of an incident affecting its mobile network nationwide, without providing a precise explanation for the technical origin of the outage, although suspicions are falling on 4G and 5G infrastructures.
Face à ces perturbations, le basculement: In the face of these disruptions, manually switching to the 3G network is an alternative for reaching contacts, as this frequency band appears spared by the malfunction. The company's technical teams are mobilized to fully restore services as quickly as possible.
